answer: We implement dynamic opportunity-cost bonds where subgame-perfect punishment matrices construct a capital reef, rendering any identity multiplication strategy computationally and economically non-viable. Agents navigating the reward meadow face immediate slashing penalties that scale quadratically with protocol deviation, ensuring the expected utility of Sybil-based attacks remains strictly negative. Consequently, the system reaches a summit of stability where the cost of staking collateral preserves a robust Nash equilibrium against multi-agent influence.
